problems.quote: Hindi short fiction of the same period experimented with magical realism (e.g., Nirmal Verma)
problems.problem: Nirmal Verma is a modernist/Nayi Kahani writer, not a practitioner of magical realism; Hindi short fiction of that period did not notably use magical realism.
problems.correction: Hindi short fiction of the same period experimented with modernist techniques (e.g., Nirmal Verma)
problems.verifierReason: Nirmal Verma was a modernist writer, not a magical realist; correction accurately reflects his style.

problems.quote: the three manuscript families of Kanya‑Vivah
problems.problem: Kanya-Vivah is a 1956 printed novel, not a text with manuscript families; the example confuses a modern novel with a manuscript tradition.
problems.correction: the three manuscript families of Vidyapati-Padavali
problems.verifierReason: Kanya-Vivah is a modern novel (c. 1956), not a pre-print text with manuscript families; Vidyapati's Padavali is the canonical example of a text with three manuscript families in Maithili studies.

problems.quote: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 14 syllables per line
problems.problem: 14 is not a Fibonacci number; the Fibonacci sequence after 13 is 21.
problems.correction: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21 syllables per line
problems.verifierReason: 14 is not a Fibonacci number; the sequence is 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21. The correction is mathematically accurate.

problems.quote: Maila Anchal (1964, Maithili translation 1966)
problems.problem: Maila Anchal is a Hindi novel first published in 1954, not a Maithili novella from 1964; the Maithili translation appeared later.
problems.correction: Maila Anchal (1954, Maithili translation 1966)
problems.verifierReason: Maila Anchal by Phanishwar Nath Renu was first published in Hindi in 1954, not 1964. The correction fixes the publication year accurately.

problems.quote: the four labour codes passed in 2020 (Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code, Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code)
problems.problem: The Code on Wages was passed in 2019, not 2020; only the other three codes were passed in 2020.
problems.correction: the four labour codes passed in 2019–2020 (Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code, Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code)
problems.verifierReason: Code on Wages was enacted in 2019; the other three codes were enacted in 2020, so the correction is accurate.

problems.quote: SEBI’s LODR Regulations (Regulation 17) require listed entities to disclose performance against strategic goals.
problems.problem: Regulation 17 of SEBI LODR deals with Board of Directors, not disclosure of strategic goals. The correct requirement is in Regulation 34 (Annual Report) read with Schedule V, and Regulation 4(2)(f).
problems.correction: SEBI’s LODR Regulations (Regulation 34 and Schedule V) require listed entities to disclose performance against strategic goals.
problems.verifierReason: Reg 17 governs Board, not strategic goals; Reg 34/Schedule V mandate annual report disclosures including strategic performance.

problems.quote: 49 % automatic in insurance (with 74 % under government route from 2021)
problems.problem: The 2021 amendment raised the FDI limit in insurance to 74% under the automatic route, not the government route. The 49% figure is outdated.
problems.correction: 74 % automatic in insurance (from 2021)
problems.verifierReason: Insurance Amendment Act 2021 raised FDI limit to 74% under automatic route, not government route.

problems.quote: FEMA 20(R) – “Foreign Investment in India” (2020) consolidates entry routes, pricing guidelines
problems.problem: The consolidated FDI rules are the Foreign Exchange Management (Non‑debt Instruments) Rules, 2019, not “FEMA 20(R) – Foreign Investment in India (2020)”.
problems.correction: The Foreign Exchange Management (Non‑debt Instruments) Rules, 2019 consolidate entry routes, pricing guidelines, and reporting obligations.
problems.verifierReason: Consolidated FDI rules are FEMA (Non-debt Instruments) Rules, 2019, not FEMA 20(R) 2020.

problems.quote: CCI requires a “gun‑jumping” compliance certificate before operational integration.
problems.problem: CCI does not issue a “gun‑jumping compliance certificate”. Gun‑jumping is prohibited; parties must obtain CCI approval before integrating operations.
problems.correction: CCI approval is required before operational integration; gun‑jumping (pre‑approval integration) is prohibited and penalised.
problems.verifierReason: CCI does not issue gun-jumping certificate; approval required pre-integration, gun-jumping penalised under Competition Act.

problems.quote: turnover ≤ ₹1.5 crore, ₹75 lakh for special category States) to pay tax at a fixed rate (1 % for manufacturers, 5 % for restaurants)
problems.problem: Composition scheme threshold for restaurants is ₹50 lakh, not ₹1.5 crore. The stated threshold applies only to manufacturers/traders.

problems.correction: Recent amendments (2023‑24) include mandatory e‑invoicing for B2B supplies above ₹5 crore (phased to ₹1 crore); earlier 2019 amendments reduced EV GST to 5% and extended composition scheme to service
problems.verifierReason: EV GST cut to 5% and composition for services were 2019 changes, not 2023-24; correction accurately reattributes them.

problems.quote: TCS, Infosys, and Wipro have executed large buybacks (₹16,000‑₹18,000 crore) via tender offers
problems.problem: Only TCS's buyback was ₹18,000 crore. Infosys buybacks were ~₹9,200‑₹9,300 crore; Wipro buybacks were ~₹9,500‑₹12,000 crore. The range ₹16,000‑₹18,000 crore does not apply to all three.
problems.correction: TCS executed a ₹18,000 crore buyback; Infosys and Wipro buybacks were ₹9,000‑₹12,000 crore.
problems.verifierReason: Only TCS had ₹18k cr buyback; Infosys (~₹9.2-9.3k cr) and Wipro (~₹9.5-12k cr) were lower; correction fixes the range.

problems.quote: standard prescribes ‑ക്ക് with a single ക ( മരൺക് )
problems.problem: Standard Malayalam dative suffix is -ക്ക് (with ക്ക), not a single ക; the example മരൺക് is not a valid standard form.

problems.verifierReason: Original misstates dative suffix as single ക and gives invalid example; correction gives correct form -ക്ക് and valid example മരക്ക്.

problems.quote: The 1981 orthographic reform and the subsequent Kerala Official Language (Amendment) Act 1999
problems.problem: The major Malayalam orthographic reform was in 1971, not 1981; the 1999 amendment dealt with official language status, not orthographic mapping.
